claims.claim: Implemented the bounded transport and self-hosted workflow with only event identity and fixed repository inputs; operational binding remains machine-local.
Terminal attention dispatches directly after successful admission through an explicit Human-controlled enable gate, with no added polling, schedule, workflow_run, Work, or Issue-retrigger path.
The adapter attaches through configured loopback CDP, requires one exact already-open target and guarded authenticated regular-chat composer state, and never launches a browser or navigates pages.
External bounded state persists ATTEMPTING before submission and SUBMITTED after proof; duplicates are NOOPs and uncertain attempts block automatic resend.

The doorbell contains only the required bounded fields. Proof inspects exact outbound user text and composer/send state; receipts exclude binding and session material, and no assistant-output extraction is implemented.

Added deterministic synthetic coverage for delivery, dedupe, binding failures, target-page ambiguity, surface rejection, drafts, generation, pre-submit failure, uncertain attempts, and submission proof without live ChatGPT access.
Committed changes are confined to the seven authorized files and implement transport only, without live probing, semantic continuation, lifecycle routing, or canonical-state mutation.
